end.parentNote: Asha practised distinguishing observations, hypotheses, and predictions with Tara. Tara used the key method of asking whether an idea can be tested and later restated that an observation is what has happened while a hypothesis is a testable idea about what may happen. There was a mix-up between prediction and hypothesis, and it was partly corrected later, though the final teach-back was not passed. At home, ask Tara to sort a few examples into “observation,” “prediction,” or “hypothesis,” and explain why each belongs there.
